description: Reply to a review of your business, given reviewId and accountId from soclo_inbox_reviews. UNLIKE a direct-message reply, a review reply IS PUBLIC: visible to anyone who can see the listing. Pass confirm: true only after the owner approved the exact text; without it, this returns a preview and sends nothing at all. Needs the separate manage:inbox permission.

accountId.description: The connected account id, from soclo_accounts_list or a prior inbox call.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact text or change. Omit or pass false to get a preview instead: nothing is sent, nothing is saved.

message.description: The exact text to send, approved by the owner.

name: soclo_inbox_reply_review
title: Reply to a review publicly
